137	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the three samplers (one session each)
138	def _session_bootstrap(fit, rng, level):
139	    j = rng.integers(fit["n_pool"])
140	    ref = fit["O"][j, 0]
141	    o, h, l, c = (fit[k][j] / ref * level for k in "OHLC")
142	    return o, h, l, c, fit["V"][j].copy()
143	
144	
145	def _segment_bootstrap(fit, rng, level):
146	    n = fit["n_full"]; o = np.empty(n); h = np.empty(n); l = np.empty(n); c = np.empty(n); v = np.empty(n)
147	    anchor = level
148	    for j0 in range(0, n, BLOCK):
149	        j1 = min(n, j0 + BLOCK); j = rng.integers(fit["n_pool"])
150	        ref = fit["O"][j, 0] if j0 == 0 else fit["C"][j, j0 - 1]
151	        for arr, k in ((o, "O"), (h, "H"), (l, "L"), (c, "C")): arr[j0:j1] = fit[k][j, j0:j1] / ref * anchor
152	        v[j0:j1] = fit["V"][j, j0:j1]
153	        anchor = c[j1 - 1]
154	    return o, h, l, c, v
155	
156	
157	def _gmm_markov(fit, rng, level, atr):
158	    n = fit["n_full"]; K = fit["gmm_k"]; g = fit["gmm"]
159	    states = np.empty(n, dtype=int); states[0] = rng.choice(K, p=fit["init"])
160	    for k in range(1, n): states[k] = rng.choice(K, p=fit["trans"][states[k - 1]])
161	    Z = np.empty((n, 4))
162	    for s in range(K):
163	        m = states == s
164	        if m.any(): Z[m] = rng.multivariate_normal(g.means_[s], g.covariances_[s], size=int(m.sum()))
165	    Z = np.clip(Z * fit["z_sd"] + fit["z_mu"], fit["z_lo"], fit["z_hi"])           # un-standardise; clip to the IS observed range per dimension
166	    o = np.empty(n); h = np.empty(n); l = np.empty(n); c = np.empty(n); v = np.empty(n)
167	    prev = level
168	    for k in range(n):
169	        r, lvr, rra, cp = Z[k]
170	        o[k] = prev; c[k] = prev * np.exp(r)
171	        rng_ = max(max(rra, 0.0) * atr, abs(c[k] - o[k]), TICK)
172	        cp = min(max(cp, 0.0), 1.0)
173	        lo = c[k] - cp * rng_; hi = lo + rng_
174	        l[k] = min(lo, o[k], c[k]); h[k] = max(hi, o[k], c[k])
175	        v[k] = max(1.0, round(np.exp(lvr) * fit["vol_profile"][k]))
176	        atr = atr + ((h[k] - l[k]) - atr) / ATR_N                       # Wilder update on the generated bar (TR = high - low since open = previous close)
177	        prev = c[k]
178	    return o, h, l, c, v, atr, states
179	
180	
181	def sample_tape(fit, gen, k, calendar=None):
182	    """One tape as a DataFrame in the near-month format. calendar: rows (date, contract, expiry) = the sessions to write
183	    (default: every IS session date). Session s opens at level_{s-1} x exp(gap) with gap drawn from the IS gaps (0 for s = 0)."""
184	    rng = np.random.default_rng(_seed(fit["tf"], gen, k))
185	    cal = fit["calendar"] if calendar is None else calendar
186	    n = fit["n_full"]; level = fit["level0"]; atr = fit["atr0"]
187	    frames = []; state_log = []
188	    for s, row in enumerate(cal.itertuples(index=False)):
189	        gap = 0.0 if s == 0 else float(rng.choice(fit["gaps"]))
190	        level_open = level * np.exp(gap)
191	        if gen == "session": o, h, l, c, v = _session_bootstrap(fit, rng, level_open)
192	        elif gen == "segment": o, h, l, c, v = _segment_bootstrap(fit, rng, level_open)
193	        elif gen == "gmm":
194	            o, h, l, c, v, atr, st = _gmm_markov(fit, rng, level_open, atr); state_log.append(np.bincount(st, minlength=fit["gmm_k"]))
195	        else: raise ValueError(gen)
196	        o, h, l, c = (_round_tick(x) for x in (o, h, l, c))
197	        h = np.maximum(h, np.maximum(o, c)); l = np.minimum(l, np.minimum(o, c))
198	        frames.append(pd.DataFrame(dict(datetime=[f"{row.date} {hm}" for hm in fit["clock"]], open=o, high=h, low=l, close=c,
199	                                        volume=v.astype(np.int64), oi=0, contract=row.contract, expiry=row.expiry, front_month=1)))
200	        level = float(c[-1])
201	    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
202	    return df, dict(state_counts=np.sum(state_log, axis=0).tolist() if state_log else None)
203	
204	
205	def write_tape(fit, gen, k, path, calendar=None):
206	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
207	    df, info = sample_tape(fit, gen, k, calendar)
208	    for col in ("open", "high", "low", "close"): df[col] = df[col].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}")
209	    df.to_csv(path, index=False)
210	    meta = dict(tf=fit["tf"], gen=gen, k=k, seed=_seed(fit["tf"], gen, k), rows=int(len(df)), sessions=int(len(df) // fit["n_full"]),
211	                first=df.datetime.iloc[0], last=df.datetime.iloc[-1], fitted_on="IS bars only (split == IS of fz_v3/out/data/<tf>/bars.parquet)", **info)
212	    json.dump(meta, open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(path), "tape_meta.json"), "w"), indent=1)
213	    return meta
214	
215	
216	def one_year_calendar(fit, sessions=247):
217	    """The last `sessions` IS session dates (the 1-minute tapes are one trading year long)."""
218	    return fit["calendar"].iloc[-sessions:].reset_index(drop=True)
219

222	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
223	    ap.add_argument("--tf", required=True, choices=("minute", "5minute")); ap.add_argument("--gen", required=True, choices=GENS)
224	    ap.add_argument("--k", type=int, required=True); ap.add_argument("--out", required=True); ap.add_argument("--one-year", action="store_true")
225	    a = ap.parse_args()

12	Rule-list grammar (the one the LLM-hypothesis study uses, rules_round0.json): a list of rules, each
13	    {"if": [[column, op, value], ...] (at most 3 comparisons, conjunction), "then": "skip"}
14	over as-of columns of features.parquet; ops >=, >, <=, <, ==, !=, in, not_in. A SETUP is skipped when ANY rule fires
15	(disjunction of conjunctions); NaN never satisfies a comparison. A dict {"rules": [...]} or {"minute": [...], "5minute": [...]}
16	is accepted too (the timeframe list is picked by the tape's tf). A rule may carry "then": "keep" — then the listed rules are
17	the KEEP set (a SETUP is kept when any keep rule fires); mixing keep and skip rules in one list is refused.

19	How a candidate is evaluated on the tapes later: for every tape folder under tapes/<tf>/, evaluate_rule_list(folder, rules)
20	gives the tape's diff and control percentile; the candidate's real-tape diff (its ledger row) is compared with the p95 of the
21	tape diffs per generator (null_distributions.json holds the frozen gate's and the mechanical gates' nulls as the reference;
22	a candidate passes the null-tape check when its real-tape diff is above the GMM-Markov p95 AND above the segment p95, and

60	def mechanical_masks(T):
61	    """The three reference gates' keep masks on a Table (real or tape): frozen, choch2, sl above the table's own IS median."""
62	    F = T.F
63	    frozen = F.fz_traded.astype(bool).to_numpy()

72	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- rule lists
73	_OPS = {">=": np.greater_equal, ">": np.greater, "<=": np.less_equal, "<": np.less, "==": np.equal, "!=": np.not_equal}

75	
76	def _cmp(series, op, value):
77	    if op in ("in", "not_in"):
78	        vals = [str(v) for v in (value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)) else [value])]
79	        s = series.astype(object).map(lambda z: None if z is None or (isinstance(z, float) and np.isnan(z)) else str(z))
80	        hit = s.isin(vals).to_numpy() & s.notna().to_numpy()
81	        return hit if op == "in" else (~hit & s.notna().to_numpy())
82	    if op not in _OPS: raise ValueError(f"unknown op {op}")
83	    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series) or pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
84	        x = series.to_numpy(dtype=float)
85	        v = float(value) if not isinstance(value, bool) else float(value)
86	        with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"): hit = _OPS[op](x, v)
87	        return hit & np.isfinite(x)
88	    so = series.astype(object)
89	    if op in ("==", "!="):
90	        s = so.map(lambda z: None if z is None or (isinstance(z, float) and np.isnan(z)) else str(z))
91	        hit = (s == str(value)).to_numpy() & s.notna().to_numpy()
92	        return hit if op == "==" else (~hit & s.notna().to_numpy())
93	    x = pd.to_numeric(so, errors="coerce").to_numpy(dtype=float)
94	    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"): hit = _OPS[op](x, float(value))
95	    return hit & np.isfinite(x)

98	def rules_for(rules, tf):
99	    if isinstance(rules, dict):
100	        if "rules" in rules: rules = rules["rules"]
101	        elif tf in rules: rules = rules[tf]
102	        else: raise ValueError("rule JSON needs 'rules' or a per-timeframe list")
103	    return list(rules)

106	def rule_mask(F, rules, tf):
107	    """(fires, mode): fires[i] = any rule's conjunction holds on row i; mode = 'skip' or 'keep'."""
108	    rules = rules_for(rules, tf)
109	    modes = {str(r.get("then", "skip")).lower() for r in rules}
110	    if len(modes) > 1: raise ValueError(f"a rule list mixes {sorted(modes)}; use one mode")
111	    mode = modes.pop() if modes else "skip"
112	    fires = np.zeros(len(F), dtype=bool)
113	    for r in rules:
114	        conds = r["if"]
115	        if len(conds) > 3: raise ValueError(f"rule {r.get('id')} has depth {len(conds)} > 3")
116	        m = np.ones(len(F), dtype=bool)
117	        for col, op, val in conds:
118	            if col not in F.columns: raise KeyError(f"rule {r.get('id')}: column {col} not in the feature table")
119	            if col.startswith(H.LABEL_PREFIX) or col in H.NOT_FEATURES: raise PermissionError(f"rule {r.get('id')}: {col} is not an as-of feature")
120	            m &= _cmp(F[col], op, val)
121	        fires |= m
122	    return fires, mode

144	def bar_stats(bars, sessions=None, is_only=True):
145	    """Per-bar within-session log-return std (bps), excess kurtosis, autocorrelation of |r| at lags 1-5 (pairs inside a session),
146	    the price level range and the median ATR14."""
147	    B = bars
148	    if is_only and "split" in B.columns: B = B[B.split.astype(str) == "IS"]
149	    B = B.sort_values("i") if "i" in B.columns else B
150	    c = B.close.to_numpy(dtype=float); s = B.session_idx.to_numpy()
151	    same = s[1:] == s[:-1]
152	    r = np.log(c[1:] / c[:-1])[same]                                     # within-session close-to-close returns
153	    ss = s[1:][same]
154	    out = dict(bars=int(len(B)), ret_std_bps=round(float(r.std() * 1e4), 3), ret_kurt_excess=round(float(pd.Series(r).kurt()), 3),
155	               ret_mean_bps=round(float(r.mean() * 1e4), 4))
156	    a = np.abs(r) - np.abs(r).mean()
157	    for lag in range(1, 6):
158	        m = ss[lag:] == ss[:-lag]
159	        x, y = a[lag:][m], a[:-lag][m]
160	        out[f"absret_ac{lag}"] = round(float((x * y).mean() / (a.var() + 1e-18)), 4)
161	    out.update(close_min=float(c.min()), close_max=float(c.max()), close_first=float(c[0]), close_last=float(c[-1]),
162	               atr14_median=round(float(B.atr14.median()), 3) if "atr14" in B.columns else None,
163	               volume_mean=round(float(B.volume.mean()), 1), zero_volume_bars=int((B.volume == 0).sum()))
164	    return out

2	both judges' fixes: IS-early vs IS-late now; the IS-vs-OOS check is NOT run here, it belongs to oos_once.py's post-mortem).
3	
4	    python drift.py                      # both timeframes -> drift.json, drift_<tf>_features.csv, drift.log
5	
6	Definition (fixed before any number): unit = the L1 unit table (harness.load(tf), IS rows only). Label = 1 when the SETUP's session
7	date is in IS-late (2023-10-01 .. 2025-12-31), 0 when in IS-early (2021-10-01 .. 2023-09-30). Design matrix = harness.design(T)
8	over Table.asof_columns() (floats as they are, booleans 0/1, text one-hot <= 16 levels); HistGradientBoostingClassifier handles
9	NaN natively. Cross-validation = harness.purged_splits (12 contiguous IS blocks, purge by the label's exit bar, 3-session
10	embargo); the reported AUC is the pooled out-of-fold AUC over all IS rows (single blocks are mostly one class, so per-fold AUCs
11	are undefined). Chance level = the same pooled OOF AUC with the early / late label permuted across rows, 20 permutations
12	(p50, p95). Two design variants: (A) every as-of column; (B) without the time proxies = as-of columns whose |Spearman rho| with
13	session_idx over IS rows is >= 0.9 (n_events_asof is one by construction: the cumulative event count since the data start),
14	listed in the output; the drift ranking uses (B) so that the ranked features are drift in the market, not the calendar.
15	Ranking = mean |SHAP| (shap.TreeExplainer on the model refit on all IS rows of (B)); each of the top 20 carries its direction of
16	drift = the sign of (mean late - mean early) with the standardised shift, the KS statistic between the two periods, and the
17	sign of the SHAP-feature correlation (positive = higher values push toward 'late').
18	Rule for the gate studies (written to drift.json): a selected rule that uses one of the top-5 drifted features (variant B) is
19	refit without that feature and both versions are reported; a rule that uses a time proxy is refused.

46	def oof_auc(T, X, y, rng=None):
47	    """Pooled out-of-fold AUC over the IS rows under harness.purged_splits; y may be permuted (rng given)."""
48	    is_idx = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
49	    yy = y.copy()
50	    if rng is not None: yy[is_idx] = rng.permutation(yy[is_idx])
51	    oof = np.full(T.n, np.nan)
52	    for tr, te in H.purged_splits(T):
53	        if len(np.unique(yy[tr])) < 2: oof[te] = yy[tr].mean(); continue
54	        m = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(**HGB).fit(X[tr], yy[tr])
55	        oof[te] = m.predict_proba(X[te])[:, 1]
56	    return float(roc_auc_score(yy[is_idx], oof[is_idx])), oof

1	"""Two facts the null tapes rely on, measured (study null_tapes_drift; 5-minute IS full sessions, engine.run with the Strategy 2 rules):
2	
3	  1. the engine is scale-free: the same bars at 2x the price level give identical swing / CHoCH / BOS / SETUP counts, so the tapes'
4	     random-walk price level cannot change the engine's behaviour (INR statistics still scale with the level; see FINDINGS caveats);
5	  2. what the session bootstrap changes: the CHoCH / SETUP rate of the real IS sessions in their real order, re-based with the real
6	     gaps (identical to the real tape), with random gaps, in shuffled order with the real gap sequence, shuffled with zero gaps, and
7	     in real order with zero gaps. The engine's event rate depends on the multi-day path, which is what a null tape randomises.
8	
9	    python engine_scale_check.py     -> engine_scale_check.json
10	"""
11	import os, sys, json, time
12	sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
13	import numpy as np
14	HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
15	LAB = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "..", "..", ".."))
16	sys.path.insert(0, HERE); sys.path.insert(0, LAB)
17	import gen_tapes as G, engine                                            # noqa: E402
18	
19	RULES = dict(break_mode="touch", choch_mode="touch", avwap_weight="volume", sl_rule="choch_candle")
20	
21	
22	def counts(O, H, L, C, V):
23	    P, n = O.shape
24	    bars = dict(t=[f"{s:05d} {k:03d}" for s in range(P) for k in range(n)], o=O.ravel().tolist(), h=H.ravel().tolist(), l=L.ravel().tolist(),
25	                c=C.ravel().tolist(), v=V.ravel().tolist())
26	    r = engine.run(bars, RULES)
27	    ch = sum(1 for e in r["events"] if e["kind"] == "CHoCH")
28	    return dict(sessions=P, choch=ch, bos=len(r["events"]) - ch, setups=len(r["setups"]), swings=len(r["sw"]),
29	                choch_per_session=round(ch / P, 4), bos_per_session=round((len(r["events"]) - ch) / P, 4), setups_per_session=round(len(r["setups"]) / P, 4))
30	
31	
32	def chain(fit, order, gaps):
33	    O, H, L, C, V = (fit[k] for k in "OHLCV")
34	    o = np.empty_like(O); h = np.empty_like(O); l = np.empty_like(O); c = np.empty_like(O); v = np.empty_like(O); level = O[order[0], 0]
35	    for s, j in enumerate(order):
36	        lo = level * np.exp(gaps[s]) if s else level
37	        for dst, src in ((o, O), (h, H), (l, L), (c, C)): dst[s] = src[j] / O[j, 0] * lo
38	        v[s] = V[j]; level = c[s, -1]
39	    return o, h, l, c, v
40	
41	
42	def main():
43	    t0 = time.time()
44	    fit = G.fit_generators("5minute", verbose=False)
45	    O, H, L, C, V = (fit[k] for k in "OHLCV"); P = O.shape[0]
46	    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
47	    real_gaps = np.r_[0.0, np.log(O[1:, 0] / C[:-1, -1])]
48	    out = dict(tf="5minute", rules=RULES, pool="IS full sessions (75 bars)", sessions=int(P), runs={})
49	    out["runs"]["real_order"] = counts(O, H, L, C, V)
50	    out["runs"]["real_order_x2_price"] = counts(2 * O, 2 * H, 2 * L, 2 * C, V)
51	    out["runs"]["real_order_rebased_real_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, np.arange(P), real_gaps))
52	    out["runs"]["real_order_random_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, np.arange(P), rng.choice(fit["gaps"], P)))
53	    out["runs"]["shuffled_sessions_real_gap_sequence"] = counts(*chain(fit, rng.permutation(P), real_gaps))
54	    out["runs"]["shuffled_sessions_zero_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, rng.permutation(P), np.zeros(P)))
55	    out["runs"]["real_order_zero_gaps"] = counts(*chain(fit, np.arange(P), np.zeros(P)))
56	    out["scale_free"] = out["runs"]["real_order"] == out["runs"]["real_order_x2_price"]
57	    out["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
58	    json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(HERE, "engine_scale_check.json"), "w"), indent=1)
59	    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
60

62	if __name__ == "__main__":
63	    main()

content.subject: Install the program's Python packages (shap, hmmlearn, mapie, arch, torch, psutil) and verify imports
content.description: numpy pandas pyarrow scipy scikit-learn xgboost shap numba matplotlib joblib torch statsmodels hmmlearn mapie ruptures arch stumpy; verify every import; note versions (pandas 3.x vs local 2.3.3) in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md

content.subject: Rebuild both datasets (1m, 5m) from fz_v3/data via engine.load; cross-check against fz_v3/built; write QUALITY.md
content.description: One build script per timeframe under fz_v3/out/build/: engine.run (ST1 rules on 1m, ST2 on 5m), Foundation trades priced (lot 65, 5 pts slip, ZERODHA_NFO_FUT), fz.run with ST7/ST8 blocks, per-SETUP feature table with the same column contract as built/, plus the L1 intraday 15:25 label, the truncation causality check. Compare SETUP counts, trades, room card against fz_v3/built; the cloud rebuild wins; log discrepancies in fz_v3/out/QUALITY.md.

content.subject: Validation harness: splitter (12 IS blocks, purge by label exit, 3-session embargo), CPCV paths, append-only ledger via score(), PBO, DSR, block bootstrap, SPA
content.description: fz_v3/out/harness.py: the single evaluator. Every gate candidate goes through score(); kept-vs-skipped expectancy, session-matched random control (fz_report.random_control), permutation p (fz_report.permutation_p), CPCV 11 paths, go/no-go rule (PBO <= 0.2, CPCV p5 diff > 0, DSR p < 0.1, kept share >= 20%, kept n >= 300/80, top-1%-removed value > 0, slippage 8 pts survival). Break tests (BDE CUSUM, Chow) as pre-registration.

content.subject: Feature vocabulary pass: clustered MDA/MDI/SFI, FFD, BSADF/CUSUM, BOCPD run length, novelty scalars, SHAP interactions; freeze <= 8 clusters
content.description: quant-ml-canon-feature-importance merged with the feature contributions of regime-breaks, regime-states (BOCPD, GMM), motif (nn_dist_prefix, p1_dist_prefix), rocket window summaries. Per-year stability filter. Shortlist frozen in the ledger before any gate search.

content.subject: H1-H5 classical studies through the harness (gate audit, regime, volume, levels, learned gate) on IS
content.description: H1 what ST7/ST8 skip (precision/recall as loser filter, big winners); H2 regime grid; H3 visibly-high-volume reaction; H4 level respect vs break; H5 depth-3 tree + greedy rule list + GBM ceiling. All IS, via score(), every trial in the ledger.

content.subject: Learned-gate family: meta-labelling + full-information policy tree, distilled to rule list / scorecard; regime states; LLM hypotheses (round 0 blind, round 1 cross-fitted); FQI exit; session stop; conformal operating point; sizing
content.description: DESIGN_PANEL merged program: meta-label gate (L1 label, winsorised |net| weights, HGB/bagging ceilings, scorecard, rule list), policy trees, GMM/HMM/BOCPD regime states, LLM-hypothesis rounds with family-wise max-T permutation, FQI exit policy (learner C grid, B hindsight imitation, A FQI), session stop rule with within-session x hour null, conformal skip operating point, sizing conditional on a surviving gate, null tapes (5m), adversarial drift.
content.activeForm: Running the learned-gate family and modern-ML studies

content.subject: Walk-forward learn-after-each-trade policy with the trade journal (IS learning curve, continued through OOS); compose with rl.py for exit/size
content.description: fz_learn.py prototype: journal rows per SETUP (features, decision, reason, model state id, fill, exit, MFE/MAE, pts, gross, costs, net, R, running equity/DD/PF); online learners (LinUCB/Thompson on logistic or tree-embedded model, online GBM refits, k-trade cadence); fractional Kelly sizing with max lots and daily loss stop; learning curve vs take-all and random control; deterministic replay.

content.subject: OOS opened once by one script for at most three frozen candidates (rule list, learner, ST7/ST8 comparator)
content.description: fz_v3/out/oos_once.py reads frozen candidate JSON + sha; scores OOS 2026-01-01..2026-09-25 with random control, permutation p, kept-vs-skipped, winner recall; the learner continues updating through OOS as it would live. Caveats: OOS window = published lab window, used by ST9-12 exit grid.

import os, sys, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = os.getcwd(); OUT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, OUT); sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import harness as H, tapes

# ---- 1. recompute the null distributions from tape_results.csv and compare with null_distributions.json
R = pd.read_csv("tape_results.csv"); null = json.load(open("null_distributions.json"))
print("tape_results rows:", len(R), "by tf/gen:", R.groupby(["tf","gen"]).k.nunique().to_dict())
raw = pd.DataFrame([json.loads(x) for x in open("tape_results.jsonl") if x.strip()])
print("jsonl rows:", len(raw), "duplicates (tf,gen,k,gate):", int(raw.duplicated(["tf","gen","k","gate"]).sum()))
q = lambda v, p: round(float(np.nanquantile(v, p)), 2)
mism = []; n_pass = 0; n_tot = 0
for tf, d in null["timeframes"].items():
    real = d["real_reference"]
    for gen, g in d["generators"].items():
        for gate, v in g["gates"].items():
            s = R[(R.tf==tf)&(R.gen==gen)&(R.gate==gate)]; dv = s["diff"].to_numpy(float); cv = s["control_pct"].to_numpy(float)
            chk = dict(n=len(s), diff_p50=q(dv,.5), diff_p95=q(dv,.95), diff_p5=q(dv,.05), control_pct_p50=q(cv,.5), control_pct_p95=q(cv,.95),
                       control_pct_share_ge95=round(float(np.mean(cv>=95)),3), diff_share_positive=round(float(np.mean(dv>0)),3),
                       real_diff_percentile_in_tapes=round(float(100*np.mean(dv<real[gate]["diff"])),1),
                       tapes_same_sign_as_real=round(float(np.mean(np.sign(dv)==np.sign(real[gate]["diff"]))),3),
                       real_above_tape_p95=bool(real[gate]["diff"] > q(dv,.95)))
            n_tot += 1; n_pass += int(v["real_above_tape_p95"])
            for k_, val in chk.items():
                if v[k_] != val: mism.append((tf, gen, gate, k_, v[k_], val))
print("null_distributions mismatches:", mism if mism else "none"); print("real_above_tape_p95:", n_pass, "of", n_tot)

# ---- 2. the six real reference gates recomputed from the data (H.metrics, controls off: nothing written)
for tf in ("5minute", "minute"):
    T = H.load(tf); masks, info = tapes.mechanical_masks(T)
    rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
    ref = json.load(open(f"real_reference_{tf}.json"))
    print(f"\n{tf}: IS units {len(rows)}, OOS units {int(T.oos_mask.sum())}, sl_dist_atr IS median {info['sl_dist_atr_is_median']:.5f} (json {ref['sl_dist_atr_is_median']})")
    for name, keep in masks.items():
        m = H.metrics(T, keep, rows, "refuter", controls=False)
        r = ref["gates"][name]
        print(f"  {name:22s} kept_n {m['kept_n']} (json {r['kept_n']}) diff {m['diff']} (json {r['diff']}) top1rm {m['diff_top1_removed']} (json {r['diff_top1_removed']}) sign_blocks {m['sign_blocks']} (json {r['sign_blocks']}) loser_recall {m['loser_recall']} (json {r['loser_recall']})")
    # drift label split
    y = (T.day > "2023-09-30").astype(int); is_idx = rows
    print(f"  drift label: early {int((y[is_idx]==0).sum())} late {int((y[is_idx]==1).sum())}; T.day dtype sample {T.day[0]!r} .. {T.day[is_idx[-1]]!r}; max IS day {T.day[is_idx].max()} min OOS day {T.day[T.oos_mask].min() if T.oos_mask.any() else None}")
    # any as-of column that is a raw price / near-time-proxy (|rho| >= 0.8) on IS rows
    from scipy import stats as sst
    X, src = H.design(T); sess = T.session[is_idx].astype(float); hi = []
    for c in X.columns:
        x = X[c].to_numpy(float)[is_idx]; ok = np.isfinite(x)
        if ok.sum() > 50 and np.nanstd(x[ok]) > 0:
            rho = sst.spearmanr(x[ok], sess[ok]).statistic
            if abs(rho) >= 0.8: hi.append((c, round(float(rho),3)))
    print("  |rho| >= 0.8 with session_idx:", sorted(hi, key=lambda z: -abs(z[1])))
    print("  design cols:", X.shape[1], "| 'sl' in asof:", "sl" in T.asof_columns(), "| fz_traded in asof:", "fz_traded" in T.asof_columns(), "| any label prefix in asof:", [c for c in T.asof_columns() if c.startswith(H.LABEL_PREFIX)])

# ---- 3. bars split sanity for the generator fit: IS bars' dates <= 2025-12-31, OOS untouched
for tf in ("5minute", "minute"):
    B = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "data", tf, "bars.parquet"), columns=["datetime", "session_idx", "split"])
    isb = B[B.split.astype(str)=="IS"]; oob = B[B.split.astype(str)!="IS"]
    print(f"\n{tf} bars: IS {len(isb)} (max {isb.datetime.max()}), OOS {len(oob)} (min {oob.datetime.min()}), IS sessions {isb.session_idx.nunique()}")

# ---- 4. tapes: all rows IS? dates? level? one tape per tf
for tf, k in (("5minute","gmm_0"), ("minute","gmm_0"), ("minute","session_3")):
    f = os.path.join("tapes", tf, k)
    F = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(f, "features.parquet"), columns=["setup_i","date","split","traded","l1_taken","fz_traded","n_choch_since_bos","sl_dist_atr","in_warmup","l1_net_inr"])
    S = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(f, "sessions.parquet"))
    print(f"\n{tf}/{k}: setups {len(F)}, split values {F.split.astype(str).unique().tolist()}, dates {F.date.min()}..{F.date.max()}, sessions {len(S)} split {S.split.astype(str).unique().tolist()}, warmup sessions {int(S.in_warmup.astype(bool).sum())}, L1 units {int((F.traded.astype(bool)&F.l1_taken.astype(bool)).sum())}, fz_traded {int(F.fz_traded.astype(bool).sum())}")

# ---- 5. drift.json merged == per-tf files
d = json.load(open("drift.json")); d5 = json.load(open("drift_5minute.json")); dm = json.load(open("drift_minute.json"))
print("\ndrift.json tfs:", list(d["timeframes"]), "| 5m equal:", d["timeframes"]["5minute"] == d5["timeframes"]["5minute"], "| 1m equal:", d["timeframes"]["minute"] == dm["timeframes"]["minute"])
for tf in ("5minute","minute"):
    v = d["timeframes"][tf]["variants"]
    print(tf, {k: (x["auc_oof"], x["perm_auc_p50"], x["perm_auc_p95"], x["n_perm"], x["columns"]) for k, x in v.items()}, "proxies", d["timeframes"][tf]["time_proxies"], "top5", d["timeframes"][tf]["top5_sources"])
    c = json.load(open(f"drift_cache_{tf}_B_without_time_proxies.json")); print("  cache B:", c["auc_oof"], c["n_perm"], len(c["perm_aucs"]), "max perm", c["perm_auc_max"])
fj = json.load(open("findings.json")); print("\nfindings.json: null_result", fj["null_result"], "candidates", fj["candidates"], "families", fj["ledger_families"], "ledger_ids", fj["ledger_ids"])

    print(f"  drift label: early {int((y[is_idx]==0).sum())} late {int((y[is_idx]==1).sum())}; T.day dtype sample {T.day[0]!r} .. {T.day[is_idx[-1]]!r}; max IS day {T.day[is_idx].max()} min OOS day {T.day[T.oos_mask].min() if T.oos_mask.any() else None}")
    # any as-of column that is a raw price / near-time-proxy (|rho| >= 0.8) on IS rows
    from scipy import stats as sst
    X, src = H.design(T); sess = T.session[is_idx].astype(float); hi = []
    for c in X.columns:
        x = X[c].to_numpy(float)[is_idx]; ok = np.isfinite(x)
        if ok.sum() > 50 and np.nanstd(x[ok]) > 0:
            rho = sst.spearmanr(x[ok], sess[ok]).statistic
            if abs(rho) >= 0.8: hi.append((c, round(float(rho),3)))
    print("  |rho| >= 0.8 with session_idx:", sorted(hi, key=lambda z: -abs(z[1])))
    print("  design cols:", X.shape[1], "| 'sl' in asof:", "sl" in T.asof_columns(), "| fz_traded in asof:", "fz_traded" in T.asof_columns(), "| any label prefix in asof:", [c for c in T.asof_columns() if c.startswith(H.LABEL_PREFIX)])

    isb = B[B.split.astype(str)=="IS"]; oob = B[B.split.astype(str)!="IS"]

# ---- 4. tapes: all rows IS? dates? level? one tape per tf
for tf, k in (("5minute","gmm_0"), ("minute","gmm_0"), ("minute","session_3")):
    f = os.path.join("tapes", tf, k)
    F = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(f, "features.parquet"), columns=["setup_i","date","split","traded","l1_taken","fz_traded","n_choch_since_bos","sl_dist_atr","in_warmup","l1_net_inr"])

# ---- 5. drift.json merged == per-tf files
d = json.load(open("drift.json")); d5 = json.load(open("drift_5minute.json")); dm = json.load(open("drift_minute.json"))
print("\ndrift.json tfs:", list(d["timeframes"]), "| 5m equal:", d["timeframes"]["5minute"] == d5["timeframes"]["5minute"], "| 1m equal:", d["timeframes"]["minute"] == dm["timeframes"]["minute"])
for tf in ("5minute","minute"):

    print(tf, {k: (x["auc_oof"], x["perm_auc_p50"], x["perm_auc_p95"], x["n_perm"], x["columns"]) for k, x in v.items()}, "proxies", d["timeframes"][tf]["time_proxies"], "top5", d["timeframes"][tf]["top5_sources"])
    c = json.load(open(f"drift_cache_{tf}_B_without_time_proxies.json")); print("  cache B:", c["auc_oof"], c["n_perm"], len(c["perm_aucs"]), "max perm", c["perm_auc_max"])

    ch = E[E.kind=="CHoCH"]; last_ch_sess = int(B.set_index("i").loc[int(ch.i.max())].session_idx) if len(ch) else -1
    n_s = len(S); after = n_s - 1 - last_ch_sess
    # longest CHoCH-free stretch in sessions
    cs = np.sort(B.set_index("i").loc[ch.i.to_numpy()].session_idx.to_numpy()); gaps = np.diff(np.r_[0, cs, n_s-1])
    u = R[(R.tf==tf)&(R.gen==gen)&(R.k==int(k))&(R.gate=="frozen_st7_st8")].n.iloc[0]

    E = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,"events.parquet"), columns=["i","kind"]); B = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT,"data",tf,"bars.parquet"), columns=["i","session_idx","split"])

issues.what: Engine lock-out on 12 of 84 null tapes is undisclosed and the certificate caveat mis-states it. On 11/60 five-minute tapes (gmm 6,16,18,19; segment 3,7; session 0,7,13,16,18) and 1/24 minute tapes (session_3) the engine's protected level freezes, the level random-walks away and the CHoCH stream stops permanently while BOS continues at the normal rate, so SETUPs stop for 31-91% of the tape's sessions. The FINDINGS caveat says per-tape unit counts 'differ by up to 3x'; measured 5m spread is 78 vs 1,211 units (15.5x). The pre-registered poor-null flag is applied to the per-generator median SETUP rate and cannot detect a dead tape. The certificate p95 values (the deliverable a shipped key carries) move when the locked tapes are excluded: 5m GMM frozen p95 708.82 -> 560.81 (-21%), 1m session frozen 468.29 -> 226.14 (-52%); other cells move -4%..+12% in both directions. The maximum of the 5m GMM frozen null (1,325.57, control pct 100) is gmm_6, a tape dead for 641 of 1,026 sessions with 370 units. None of the 18 reference verdicts flips (0/18 pass either way), so the reference readings stand, but the certificate numbers and the pass bar future candidates will be held to include tapes on which the engine did not run.
